_doc: Ocean Whisperer (Curaçao-core) captive demand anchors. Sourced volumes are real (year + source). Capture (~55% captive) and per-leg fares are MODEL INPUTS flagged for the cascade, NOT sealed. Derived from ABC-DEMAND-ANCHORS.json (Curaçao slice) + OCEAN-WHISPERER-FINE-TUNING.md. broad-footprint-first; null beats confidently-wrong.
_method: Real Curaçao tourism/cruise volumes establish the demand pool; the captive resort/cruise transfer subset is the addressable floor. Capture 0.55 + fares applied in the cascade. The pitch reframes territory-wide figures as CAPTIVE luxury (resort guests + OW cruise-aggregator network), not the whole island.
_capture_note: Captive ~55% (Jaideep 24-Jun) — NOT FP's ~90%. ~45% headroom remains → cascade ladder must RISE (SOM < SAM < TAM). Do not flat-line like FP.
